allowed_claims: PhytoBench validates benchmark source, row, split, independence, licensing, blinding, and receipt contracts under synthetic adversarial tests.
The release reproducibly builds and replays on Python 3.10 through 3.13.
The official-source discovery queue is metadata-only and contains no promoted biological row.
prohibited_claims: PhytoBench or PhytoAllele is a scientific breakthrough.
Any source-discovery record establishes a causal gene.
Matched decoys or phenotype permutations establish the empirical null denominator.
The 35/73 minima replace a benchmark-specific power analysis.
Any gene-editing target, sequence, reagent, experiment, or clinical action is authorized.
remaining_blocker: Licensed primary evidence, historical pre-truth snapshots, independent dual curation, empirical-equivalence nulls, a frozen powered benchmark, and an external-species replication are absent.
